lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr12Mg2Mn2 (Sr6MgMn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Mn each adopt tetrahedral environments coordinated by four Sr neighbors, while Sr centers have 8- and 9-coordinate geometric neighbors. The Mg- and Mn-centered tetrahedra share corners with each other and with 9-vertex Sr polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
